summary: Published reply-router runx skill classifies inbound replies, writes durable unsubscribe suppression packets through data-store, stops on unsealed or ambiguous inputs, and proves install, hosted harness, and dogfood receipt verification for bounty #70.
publish_method: Authenticated hosted publish through the runx public API using the GitHub-linked publish token; hosted registry ran the inline package harness and recorded status passed.

inbound_reply.content: Please unsubscribe me from these product emails immediately. Stop emailing this address.

observations.name: classification
observations.detail: Dogfood classified an inbound reply as unsubscribe with confidence above the supplied suppression_policy.confidence_threshold and evidence grounded in matched policy signals unsubscribe and stop emailing.

observations.name: suppression_write
observations.detail: The unsubscribe case emits a registry:runx/data-store@0.1.2 append_event packet keyed by aggregate_id prospect@example.com, with expected_version 7, after_version 8, and idempotency_key derived from recipient + receipt_id + classification.

observations.name: no_send
observations.detail: The skill performs no send and emits no routing_decision alongside an unsubscribe-class reply; any later send-as action is a separate governed run.

observations.name: stop_case
observations.detail: The stop_ambiguous_or_unsealed harness case refuses an unsealed original_send_receipt, emits no suppression write, no routing decision, and routes to the human_approval lane.

observations.name: hosted_harness
observations.detail: Hosted harness status passed with cases sealed_unsubscribe_suppression and stop_ambiguous_or_unsealed.

observations.name: public_pr
observations.detail: PR #175 contains skills/reply-router/SKILL.md, X.yaml, run.mjs, action-verification.json, evidence.json, verification.json, and report.md.

observations.name: operator_value
observations.detail: A new operator can install the package, classify replies, persist compliance suppressions for unsubscribe replies, and route non-unsubscribe replies only through bounded downstream send targets.
